build_quark_quantizer: build a QuarkHfHfQuantizer instance with a QuarkConfig for loading AMD Quark quantized models
validate_quark_environment: validate that the quark library is available before loading a Quark quantized model
process_model_before_weight_loading: process a PreTrainedModel by mapping it to Quark quantization before weight loading
get_weight_conversions: get weight converters that map checkpoint keys to Quark quantizer attributes during model loading
check_param_needs_quantization: check whether a model parameter needs quantization using the QuarkHfQuantizer
